name: Kichijo Nanao
source:
Part of unit Prid's

A junior who cunningly assumes the role of a regular person.
He admires the other members of his unit, calling them "geniuses", though in reality he has plenty of talent that is recognized by everyone.
He respects Chihiro very thoroughly.
